top_signals.title: Oil Climbs as Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia Continue
top_signals.summary: Three people were killed in two attacks on an Aramco oil field and an airport in Saudi Arabia’s Eastern Province Wednesday. The US State Department issued an ordered departure for non-emergency personnel and their families from the kingdom. The US move comes due to the growing threat from Houthi militants in neighboring Yemen. Abeer Abu Omar reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Kashagan Arbitration Court Invalidates $12 Billion of Cost Claim
top_signals.summary: An international court of arbitration invalidated about $12 billion of Kazakhstan’s claims against oil majors for disputed costs at the Kashagan field, according to people familiar with the matter.
